# Overview of workflow

This lab uses a **2 km x 2 km subset** of Harvard Forest (HARV) so everything fits in the class repo:

- `data/neon_chm_subset/harv_chm_YYYY.tif` — NEON canopy height model (CHM), 1 m resolution, one file per AOP flight year
- `data/harv_gedi_subset.gpkg` — quality-filtered, leaf-on GEDI footprints that fall in the same 2 km block

**Part A: NEON** — Read the CHM file for each AOP flight year and pull the year from the file name.

**Part B: matching by location** — Transform the GEDI points to NEON's coordinate system (UTM 18N, meters), buffer each point into a 25 m circle, and extract the 98th percentile of NEON CHM pixels inside each circle for every AOP year. Each value is labeled with its GEDI `shot_number` and `aop_year` (`chm_results`).

**Part C: joining and matching by time** — Join the GEDI table to `chm_results` by `shot_number`, keep rows where the GEDI year equals the AOP year, and drop non-forest footprints (NEON height < 2 m).

**Part D: comparison** — Correlation, bias, and RMSE between GEDI RH98 and NEON `chm_p98`, plus a GEDI vs. NEON plot with a 1:1 line.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(exactextractr)
```

# Instructor prep (not run by students)

Builds the class subset from the full NEON download and full GEDI file. Set to `eval = FALSE` so it doesn't run when knitting.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# full NEON download (3 AOP years of 1 km tiles) - local only, not in repo
chm_dir   <- "NEON_struct-ecosystem"
tifs      <- list.files(chm_dir, pattern = "CHM\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
tif_year  <- sub(".*DP3\\.30015\\.001\\.(\\d{4})-\\d{2}.*", "\\1", tifs)
aop_years <- sort(unique(tif_year))

# full quality-filtered GEDI footprints over HARV
harv_gedi_full <- st_read("data/lab_gedi_data.gpkg")

# find the 2 km x 2 km block with the most GEDI shots
xy <- harv_gedi_full |> st_transform(32618) |> st_coordinates()
blocks <- data.frame(x0 = floor(xy[, 1] / 2000) * 2000,
                     y0 = floor(xy[, 2] / 2000) * 2000) |>
  count(x0, y0, sort = TRUE)
head(blocks)
best <- blocks[1, ]   # change to blocks[2, ] etc. if the top block is mostly water/clearing

# crop each year's NEON map to the block and save
crop_box <- ext(best$x0, best$x0 + 2000, best$y0, best$y0 + 2000)
dir.create("data/neon_chm_subset", showWarnings = FALSE)
for (yr in aop_years) {
  chm_sub <- crop(vrt(tifs[tif_year == yr]), crop_box)
  writeRaster(chm_sub, paste0("data/neon_chm_subset/harv_chm_", yr, ".tif"),
              overwrite = TRUE, gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE"))
}

# save the GEDI shots inside the same block (back in lat/long)
box_poly <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = best$x0, ymin = best$y0,
                                xmax = best$x0 + 2000, ymax = best$y0 + 2000),
                              crs = st_crs(32618)))
harv_gedi_full |>
  st_transform(32618) |>
  st_filter(box_poly) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_write("data/harv_gedi_subset.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

# Part A: Read in/explore NEON data

```{r}
chm_files <- list.files("data/neon_chm_subset", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
aop_years <- sub(".*harv_chm_(\\d{4})\\.tif$", "\\1", chm_files)
aop_years

# look at one year
chm_1 <- rast(chm_files[1])
chm_1                         # resolution, extent, CRS
crs(chm_1, describe = TRUE)   # should be UTM zone 18N
plot(chm_1, main = paste("NEON CHM", aop_years[1]))
```

# Part B: Matching by location

```{r}
# read in GEDI footprints (lat/long)
harv_gedi <- st_read("data/harv_gedi_subset.gpkg")
anyDuplicated(harv_gedi$shot_number)   # should be 0

# GEDI footprints as 25 m circles in NEON's coordinate system
gedi_fp <- harv_gedi |>
  st_transform(crs(chm_1)) |>   # transform GEDI to NEON's coordinate system (meters)
  st_buffer(12.5)               # draw a 25 m circle around each GEDI point

# see the footprints on top of the NEON map
plot(chm_1)
plot(st_geometry(gedi_fp), add = TRUE, border = "red")

# match GEDI and NEON by location: for each AOP year, lay every GEDI circle on
# that year's NEON map and summarize the pixels inside it as the 98th percentile
chm_results <- map2(chm_files, aop_years, \(f, yr) {
  data.frame(
    shot_number = gedi_fp$shot_number,
    aop_year    = as.integer(yr),
    chm_p98     = exact_extract(rast(f), gedi_fp, fun = "quantile",
                                quantiles = 0.98, progress = FALSE)
  )
}) |> bind_rows()

chm_results <- filter(chm_results, !is.na(chm_p98))   # drop footprints with no NEON coverage
count(chm_results, aop_year)
```

# Part C: Joining and matching by time

```{r}
gedi_tbl <- harv_gedi |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(gedi_year = year(date_time),
         month     = month(date_time)) |>
  select(shot_number, gedi_year, month, rh98, rh95, pft_class, solar_elevation)

compare <- inner_join(gedi_tbl, chm_results, by = "shot_number")
nrow(compare)

# keep pairs where GEDI and NEON were measured in the same year
compare_matched <- filter(compare, gedi_year == aop_year)
count(compare_matched, aop_year, gedi_year)

# drop non-forest footprints
compare_forest <- filter(compare_matched, chm_p98 >= 2)

# save (shot_number as text so the 17-digit IDs aren't rounded)
compare_forest |>
  mutate(shot_number = as.character(shot_number)) |>
  write.csv("data/harv_gedi_neon_compare.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Part D: Comparison

```{r}
compare_forest |>
  group_by(aop_year) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    r    = cor(rh98, chm_p98),
    bias = mean(rh98 - chm_p98),              # + means GEDI reads taller than NEON
    rmse = sqrt(mean((rh98 - chm_p98)^2))
  )

ggplot(compare_forest, aes(chm_p98, rh98)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ aop_year) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "NEON CHM 98th percentile (m)", y = "GEDI RH98 (m)")
```
